Engine Room Records › Artist Roster › Firelight
ERR-007 • Ruby Mountain & Blue Ridge Sanctuary, Virginia • 1989–Present

Firelight

Heartland Acoustic Rock, Warm Campfire Harmonies & Ruby Mountain Anthology

Spanning a 16-album narrative anthology rooted in the Ruby Mountain story world, Firelight trades stadium synthesizers for warm acoustic guitars, mandolin, Hammond organ, and porch-light vocal harmonies chronicling decades of resilience and family healing.

What Kind of Music Is Firelight? Warm acoustic heartland rock, roots Americana, fingerpicked acoustic guitars, pedal steel, and intimate storytelling.
🎧 Listen to Firelight in The Listening Room ↗ 📚 Read Companion Novel on Book Reader ↗
Canonical In-Universe History

1. Canonical Band Lore & Sanctuary History

A 16-Album Acoustic Chronicle (1989–2016)

While The Stardust Engine and Fractured Prisms explore cosmic and Victorian synth-rock architectures, Firelight anchors the acoustic heartland wing of Engine Room Records. Across sixteen chronological albums—beginning with 1989's The Spark in the Pine and 1990's Chasing the Horizon through 2016's Embers of the Dawn—Firelight scores the quiet triumphs, mountain winters, and enduring bonds of the Ruby Mountain sanctuary.

Companion Literary Archive: Ruby Mountain

Every era of Firelight's catalog pairs with the Ruby Mountain literary archives on RaggieSoft Book Reader (books.raggiesoft.com/books/ruby-mountain), while all playable tracks and full lyrics stream in The Listening Room at music.raggiesoft.com/firelight.

The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel (Theatrical Soundtrack)

The original 9-track studio release. Heavily edited to fit a standard vinyl LP, this soundtrack reflects the truncated theatrical cut of the film, omitting the final two eras of the saga in favor of a studio-mandated 'happily ever after'.
